caption: The drawing depicts an interior wall with three large arches, the central arch containing a wooden door with a rectangular frame. The wall and arches are primarily light beige or off-white with subtle blue marble-like patterning, and the arches are accentuated by segmented blue stones outlining their curves. The wall is divided into three bays by vertical columns, each topped with a simple capital. The lower portion of the wall is decorated with a horizontal panel featuring a repetitive floral motif of red flowers with green stems and leaves, framed by light blue outlines. Above the arches, a decorative border runs along the top, consisting of alternating blue and red floral designs. The ceiling is a dark brown wooden beam structure, and the room is bordered at the top with a pronounced terracotta-red cornice. The floor is composed of reddish-brown square tiles that form a grid pattern. The drawing is completed in a realistic style, using watercolor and pencil or ink for details, and is signed in the lower right corner by Geoffrey Holt and Harry Mann Waddell.
title: Restoration Drawing
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
